title: Terrain workshop — smooth high-speed streaming
goal: Drive the Warthog at its existing top speed and turn through the arena. Terrain look-ahead now anticipates top speed, recent chunks stay resident briefly, and streaming power/brakes change progressively. Missing-collision freeze remains as a last safeguard. Press F8 around any remaining hitch; five seconds of earlier vehicle telemetry are included. F8 again ends capture. No vehicle top-speed or suspension tuning was reduced. Faster airborne streaming remains future work.
changes: Collision runway chunks now get priority before outer steering shoulders. The separate stress scene adds 228 deterministic features in 12 stations over three tiers. Actual lane, overhead and curved-bore collision passed all stations. The cached full course reached 44.41 m/s with zero streaming brakes, power limiting or freezes; dense first-time generation still caused substantial limiting. Existing caches and the normal 1024-feature save are preserved. A full-resolution DEM/SDF sampling prototype passed protected-field checks; playable DEM integration, terrain transitions and airborne streaming remain unfinished.
controls:
Mountain infill: arm button, then one terrain click. Configure radius, height, seed, noise, wavelength, octaves, erosion strengths/iterations and wind heading. To revise: select mountain, adjust, Apply.
Trees: Paint fir trees, hold LMB; main radius controls size. Density, height, slope and seed have labelled settings. Erase removes overlapping painted patches. Save explicitly. Undo restores edits. 600 resident painted-tree cap.
Raise/Lower: hold LMB. RMB + WASD fly; Space/Ctrl rise/fall. Wheel zoom; Shift-wheel size. F1 play/edit with readiness progress. B in play throws grenades. F8 log markers; F3 chunks; F2 briefing.
